question: Dussehra, which marks the victory of Lord Rama over Ravana, is celebrated in the Hindu month of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 1.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Dashahara is celebrated in the Hindu month of Ashwin, which falls in September or October according to the Gregorian calendar.
 
• It is a ten-day festival that marks the victory of Lord Rama over the demon king Ravana.
 
• The festival is celebrated with great fervor and enthusiasm all over India, with the burning of effigies of Ravana, his brother Kumbhakarna, and his son Meghnad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Dashahara is also known as Vijayadashami and is one of the major festivals of India.
 
• The festival is celebrated in different ways in different parts of India. In the eastern states of West Bengal, Odisha, and Assam, it marks the end of the Durga Puja festival, while in the southern state of Karnataka, it is celebrated as a day of victory of good over evil.
 
• In the northern state of Himachal Pradesh, Dashahara is celebrated as Kullu Dussehra, which is a week-long festival and attracts a large number of tourists every year.
 
• The festival is also associated with the harvest season and is a time for feasting and exchanging gifts with friends and family.
